meaning: Reconcile the standalone State Machine observer's existing syntactic ambient-effect restrictions with public verification, independently of finite result comparisons.
source_boundary: Audit every checked State Machine wrapper/provider and transitive Rule module using the pinned native TypeScript AST. Retain every selected State Machine even when finite cases are not_evaluable. Other metatypes do not acquire this profile.
native_boundary: Audit the emitted JavaScript closure for ready State Machine controls before importing or executing it. Bind phase, complete module inventory, definition and exact read hashes. Missing/forged observations, parser failure, audit drift or source/tool/native drift never yield passing evidence.
interpretation: Apply restrictions to parsed identifiers and forms, including decoded Unicode identifier escapes. Strings and comments naming forbidden words are not identifiers. Keep the existing standalone observer unchanged. This carries a selected syntactic restriction, not a complete effect system, alias analysis, JavaScript sandbox or universal purity proof.
execution: Use the existing trusted TypeScript 7.0.2 native API, bounded regular-file reads and subprocess limits. Audit before the private Node 26.8.1 semantic runner. Retain exact import guards, input/output checks, complete unmet-node accounting and late currentness invalidation. Never construct Events or execute Operations/providers.
compatibility: Preserve all 50 source predecessors, generated domain code, State Machine/Rule meanings, public source/API selection, legacy defaults and standalone observer behavior. No new package, installation, SFOL, AlchLang, publication, admission or external effect.
bounds: Use the executor's bounded regular-file and subprocess limits; reject an audit exceeding 1000000 AST visits per module or depth 512 without claiming a passing prefix. These are verification limits, not source admission changes.
